purpose: Exploratory reduction in steps, selected after observing the seed-43 confirmation; not held-out confirmation.
decision: Candidate final validation loss and absolute raw gap must each be no greater than the reference final values, with less observed active training time. No interpolation and no equivalence margin.
limitations: Numerical endpoints only; image quality equivalence is not established. A successful result needs another seed and separately tuned baselines. The original loss<0.07 and abs(gap)<0.007 targets remain separately reported.
